fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2020, we hedged approximately 4% of our projected fuel requirements for 2021. A one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel would result in approximately $2.7 million of additional annual fuel expense based on 2019 operational levels.

instrument_type_details.notes: Minimal fuel hedging due to COVID-19 operational reductions. Fuel derivative contracts (crude oil call options). Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $43K at Dec 31 2020. 8,652 thousand gallons (= 8.652M gallons) settling March 2021, covering ~4% of projected 2021 fuel requirements.
